text:
maya: heads-up — CI eval on canary model bring-up shows rerank accuracy drop (~7% absolute) for q8 variant vs fp16 baseline. failing eval job: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 :confused:

reza: which eval and dataset?

maya: rerank-eval/squad-extended (stable goldset). metric is MAP@10. baseline MAP 0.512 -> q8 0.442. noticed after yesterday's merge of `runner/cache-ttl` PR + laura's model add.

laura: I added redwood-llama3c-q8-v2 to model-catalog yesterday, but didn't touch tokenization.

oliver: infra rolled out `kv-eviction-window` change at 03:30 UTC yesterday — affected continuous batching windows possibly.

ci-bot: Test run 12345 started by @maya — logs: https://ci.internal/logs/12345

maya: ran local bisect: `git bisect start HEAD v0.27` ... found first bad commit is `a1b2c3 runner: kv eviction fix` but also model config commit `d4e5f6 model: add q8 ll3c` between runs. I'm not sure which.

reza: can you paste the bisect output?

maya: ```
Bisect log:
good  v0.27   (commit e3f4g5)
bad   HEAD    (commit f7g8h9)
first bad commit: a1b2c3 runner: kv eviction fix
```

laura: hmm. I can revert the model add on a canary and re-run, but we should test fallback to fp16 too.

oliver: infra metrics show increased cache miss rate after eviction change — KV hit rate down 12% on canaries.

sam: product: what's user impact? only rerank quality drop in eval or observed in prod logs?

maya: only seen in eval on canary traffic, no prod alerts yet. but canary uses q8 default for that model.

reza: quick experiment: force-run q8 model with `--use-kv-cache=false` and see if MAP recovers.

maya: ran it — with kv-cache disabled MAP -> 0.509 (close to baseline). so this points to KV eviction interaction with quantized kernels.

laura: OK we should hold the q8 rollout and pin canary to fp16. I'll open a PR to disable q8 in catalog and tag for hotfix.

oliver: also reverting `kv-eviction-window` is risky cluster-wide. prefer fix in runner to add eviction-safe path for quant kernels.

reza: filing issue: EVAL-4321 'q8 + kv-eviction = MAP regression'. attaching logs. I'll add to bisect notes.

ci-bot: Created issue EVAL-4321 by reza: https://tracker.internal/EVAL-4321

maya: decision: hold model rollout, create canary rollback, don't rollback infra. assign to laura+reza for root cause.

laura: PR https://git.internal/model-catalog/pulls/512 queued to unlist q8 variant from canary.

reza: I'll instrument more telemetry for token alignment and kv cache misses per request.

sam: thanks team — keep me posted, product will pause customer outreach until we confirm.

maya: noted. will update thread after RCA. :thumbsup:
